What happens to my PayPal when I die?

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026

Short answer: PayPal only takes instructions from the authorised executor or administrator of the estate. In Australia, the executor emails PayPal a cover sheet, the account email, a death certificate, a grant of probate or letters of administration, and photo ID. Any remaining balance can be paid to the linked bank account or by wire transfer.

Key facts

  • Executor or administrator only
  • AU: grant of probate or letters of administration
  • Balance paid to linked bank or by wire
  • AU email: bereavement@paypal.com.au

How do I prepare my PayPal account?

  1. Note your PayPal email in your digital estate plan so your executor can find it.
  2. After a death, the executor prepares the cover sheet and documents below.
  3. Australia: email them to bereavement@paypal.com.au. Other countries have different addresses and requirements.
  4. PayPal reviews them, closes or locks the account, and disburses any balance.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • Cover sheet stating the holder has died and the executor wants the account closed
  • The account's email address
  • Death certificate
  • Grant of Probate or Letters of Administration (or a statutory certificate if a statutory body is executor)
  • Executor's government photo ID

How long does it take?

PayPal reviews documents after receiving them; no fixed timeframe is published.

What can't be recovered?

  • Login access: PayPal closes or locks the account rather than transferring it

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my PayPal when I die?

PayPal only takes instructions from the authorised executor or administrator of the estate. In Australia, the executor emails PayPal a cover sheet, the account email, a death certificate, a grant of probate or letters of administration, and photo ID. Any remaining balance can be paid to the linked bank account or by wire transfer.

Can family close a PayPal account?

Only via the executor or administrator. PayPal asks others to contact the executor.

What happens to the money in PayPal?

PayPal can pay it to the bank account linked to the PayPal account or by wire transfer.

Is the process the same in the US and UK?

No. Each PayPal country site lists different documents and contact addresses.
